questions.question: PS II se NADPH tak electron ka Z-shaped raasta kya hai?
questions.hook: Number challenge: 680 nm aur 700 nm—ek electron route mein light do baar kyun lagti hai?

points.point: In photosystem II the reaction centre chlorophyll a absorbs 680 nm wavelength of red light causing electrons to become excited and jump into an orbit farther from the atomic nucleus. These electrons a
system consisting of cytochromes (Figure 11.5). This movement of electrons is downhill, in terms of an oxidation-reduction or redox potential scale. The electrons are not used up as they pass through
These electrons then are moved downhill again, this time to a molecule of energy-rich NADP⁺. The addition of these electrons reduces NADP⁺

film.showing_moment: Complete Figure 11.5 with both acceptors, light inputs, ETS, ATP branch, NADP⁺/NADPH aur water shorthand.

teacher_lines.roman: PS II se NADPH tak electron ka Z-shaped raasta kya hai?
Ab reaction centre se nikle electron ka raasta follow karenge, aur samjhenge ki do light boosts use NADPH formation tak kaise pahunchate hain.
teacher_lines.note: overview · screen: Realistic thylakoid membrane cutaway par PS II aur PS I ki positions; sirf PS II ke paas incoming light aur aage ke teen numbered route placeholders.

teacher_lines.roman: Reaction centre se primary acceptor ko electron donation aur P680–P700 ki identities hum pehle pehchaan chuke hain.
Yahaan teen padaav hain: PS II mein excitation, carriers se PS I tak transfer aur doosri excitation, phir final acceptor ki reduction.
Ek route mein light do baar kyun chahiye?
Dekho, beech ke transfers mein electron ki available energy ghatati hai, isliye aage reducing power banane ke liye PS I doosra boost deta hai.
Raasta PS II ke P680 reaction centre se shuru karo, jise hum special chlorophyll a site pehchaan chuke hain.
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: Ussi thylakoid cutaway mein P680 par 680 nm light; paas ke energy inset mein electron higher level par jaakar PS II acceptor tak pahunchta hai.

teacher_lines.roman: 680 nm red light absorb hone par electron excited hota hai, yaani higher-energy state mein pahunchta hai.
Isse nucleus se farther orbit mein jump ki simple picture se samajh sakte ho; molecular level par important baat higher-energy state hai.
Electron acceptor woh molecule hai jo doosre molecule se electron receive karta hai; yahaan pehla receiver primary acceptor hai.
Excited electron ka agla stop kya hai?
Dekho, acceptor electron receive karke use aage electron transport system ko hand over karta hai.
PS II acceptor se electron cytochromes wale transport system mein aata hai; cytochromes electron receive karke aage dene wale proteins hain.
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: Pehle cutaway par PS II acceptor se cytochrome-containing chain aur PS I tak electron arrows judte hain; ab P700 par 700 nm light aur doosre acceptor tak arrow ubharta hai.

teacher_lines.roman: Redox potential electron lene ya dene ki tendency ka measure hai; oxidation aur reduction ko hum electron transfer se jod chuke hain.
Chain mein transfer energetically downhill hai, yaani electron ki available energy ka kuch hissa release hota hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki energy dene par electron kharch ho gaya, par asal mein electron carriers ke beech transfer hota hai, destroy nahi hota.
Yeh chain electrons PS I tak pahunchakar uske donated electrons ki replacement deti hai.
Saath hi PS I ka P700 centre 700 nm red light se excite hokar electron apne acceptor ko donate karta hai.
Kya PS I ko light ke badle sirf PS II se electron milna kaafi hai?
Dekho, replacement electron supply banaye rakhti hai, lekin second excitation ki energy PS I ko absorbed light se hi milti hai.
Socho, ek trolley ko pehli powered lift upar le jaati hai, phir woh descending ramp par neeche aati hai.
teacher_lines.note: analogy · screen: Do powered lifts aur unke beech descending ramp par ek trolley; corresponding PS II, carrier chain aur PS I labels.

teacher_lines.roman: Ramp ke end par doosri powered lift use phir upar le jaati hai, taaki agla downhill route poora ho sake.
Kya pehla ramp paar karte hi trolley gayab ho gayi?
Dekho, trolley wahi aage pahunchti hai, lekin uski height se judi energy ghatati hai; doosri lift usse naya boost deti hai.
Yahaan trolley electron hai, dono powered lifts PS II aur PS I ki light-driven excitations hain, aur descending ramps carrier transfers hain.
Lifts ko power dene wali supply dono photosystems par absorbed light hai.
PS I acceptor ke baad electrons phir energetically downhill transfer hote hue final acceptor NADP⁺ tak pahunchte hain.
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: Ussi membrane picture mein PS I acceptor ke baad NADP⁺ endpoint judta hai; side ledger par do electron tokens aur ek H⁺ se NADPH formation.

teacher_lines.roman: NADP⁺ electron receive karne ke liye available oxidised carrier hai; electron gain se iska reduction hota hai.
NADPH ko hum reducing-power supply karne wala loaded carrier pehchaan chuke hain.
Ek NADPH banane ka electron ledger hai: NADP⁺ + 2e⁻ + H⁺ → NADPH.
Kya ek electron milte hi ek NADPH ban jaayega?
Dekho, ek NADPH ke liye do electrons aur ek proton chahiye; electrons light-driven route se aate hain aur carrier mein reducing power jama hoti hai.

questions.question: PS II se NADPH tak electron ka Z-shaped raasta kya hai?
questions.hook: Number challenge: 680 nm aur 700 nm—ek electron route mein light do baar kyun lagti hai?

film.showing_moment: Complete Figure 11.5 with both acceptors, light inputs, ETS, ATP branch, NADP⁺/NADPH aur water shorthand.

teacher_lines.roman: PS II se NADPH tak electron ka Z-shaped raasta kya hai?
Electron lekar agle molecule ko dene wala substance carrier kehlaata hai.
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: Membrane picture ke saath progressively bana energy/redox schematic: do light-driven rises aur do descending stretches; final NADP⁺ → NADPH label.

teacher_lines.roman: In carriers ko transfer ke order mein redox-potential framework par rakhne se poore route ki characteristic Z-jaisi profile milti hai.
Isliye ise Z scheme kehte hain: PS II ka light boost, chain ka downhill transfer, PS I ka doosra boost, aur NADP⁺ tak transfer.
Kya Z thylakoid membrane ka actual shape batata hai?
Dekho, Z electron-transfer energetics ka representation hai, membrane mein bana literal zigzag raasta nahi.
NADPH + H⁺ ki notation bhi milti hai; reduced carrier NADPH hai, aur saath likha H⁺ medium ka proton dikhata hai.
Carrier reduction ka chemical ledger wahi NADP⁺ + 2e⁻ + H⁺ → NADPH rahega.
Figure 11.5 mein left bracket Photosystem II aur right bracket Photosystem I identify karta hai; Light ki dashed arrows dono tak aati hain.
teacher_lines.note: figure · screen: Figure 11.5 ka clean labelled schematic, pehle dono photosystem routes highlight; phir ADP + iP → ATP branch aur aakhir mein water-input shorthand highlight.

teacher_lines.roman: Dono LHC labels wahi light harvesting complexes hain, jo captured energy centres tak pahunchate hain.
PS II se upward electron arrow pehle e⁻ acceptor tak, phir descending arrows Electron transport system se PS I tak jaate hain.
PS I se doosra upward arrow uske e⁻ acceptor tak, aur final transfer NADP⁺ se NADPH formation tak follow karo.
Transport system ke paas ADP + iP → ATP label kya jodta hai?
Dekho, iP inorganic phosphate hai, aur yeh branch electron transport ko ATP formation se jodti hai; iska mechanism aage samjhenge.
PS II ke neeche H₂O → 2e⁻ + 2H⁺ + [O] shorthand hai, aur electron arrow PS II ko supply dikhata hai.
[O] ek oxygen-atom equivalent ka accounting symbol hai; released gas O₂ hoti hai, jiske liye do aise equivalents judte hain.
Ab ek marked electron token ko P680 se follow karo: light excitation ke baad woh PS II acceptor, phir carriers aur PS I tak pahunchta hai.
teacher_lines.note: example · screen: Pehle se bane route par ek marked token ka handover; chhote ledger mein 2 electrons, 2 PS II excitations + 2 PS I excitations, aur 1 NADPH.

teacher_lines.roman: PS I ki light-driven donation se electron flow doosre acceptor ki taraf badhta hai aur aakhir NADP⁺ reduction ko supply milti hai.
Token ki count beech ke carriers par kya hoti hai?
Dekho, har handover mein electron aage transfer hota hai, consume nahi hota; marked token electron continuity samjhata hai.
Ab do electrons ka batch lo: har electron ke liye PS II aur PS I ke excitation events jodne par minimum chaar reaction-centre photon events bante hain.
Yeh two-electron batch ek proton ke saath ek NADP⁺ ko ek NADPH mein reduce kar sakta hai.
Socho, phir aage badhenge: PS II electrons bhej raha hai, lekin PS I ko light na mile, toh kya NADPH formation ka yeh route continuously chalega?
teacher_lines.note: checkpoint · screen: Complete route mein PS I ki light input band; replacement arrow bana rahe, lekin PS I se acceptor aur NADPH endpoint ki flow indication ruk jaaye.

teacher_lines.roman: Kya electron replacement aur electron excitation ek hi kaam hain?
Dekho, chain replacement electrons la sakti hai, lekin PS I ka light boost na hone par uske acceptor ki taraf sustained transfer rukega, isliye is route ki NADPH supply continue nahi hogi.
Poora order phir jodo: P680 par 680 nm light excitation, pehla acceptor, cytochrome-containing chain, aur PS I tak electron supply.
teacher_lines.note: retell · screen: Established route par order-wise gentle highlights; final focus PS II ke neeche water-input arrow par, baaki pathway quiet.

teacher_lines.roman: P700 par 700 nm light doosra excitation deti hai; doosre acceptor ke baad electrons NADP⁺ reduction tak pahunchte hain.
Do electrons aur ek proton se ek NADPH banta hai; carriers mein electrons destroy nahi hote.
Do light boosts aur downhill transfers Z scheme ki profile dete hain, aur ATP formation ki branch bhi is transport se judi hai.
Ab PS II electrons deta rahe, toh uski apni electron kami kaun poori karega?
Dekho, figure ka water-input arrow isi replacement source ki taraf ishara karta hai; ab water splitting ka poora hisaab kholenge.
Ab electron flow ko lagataar chalane ke liye PS II ki replacement supply chahiye; water splitting batayegi ki yeh electrons aur released oxygen kahaan se aate hain.

questions.question: Water splitting electron supply aur oxygen kaise deti hai?
questions.hook: P680 electron de chuka—refill bina next pulse kaise chalegi?

points.point: You would then ask, How does PS II supply electrons continuously? The

electrons that were moved from photosystem II must be replaced. This is achieved by electrons available due to splitting of water. The splitting of water is associated with the PS II; water is split i
We need to emphasise here that the water splitting complex is associated with the PS II, which itself is physically located on the inner side of the membrane of the thylakoid.
Then, where are the protons and O₂ formed likely to be released – in the lumen? or on the outer side of the membrane?

film.showing_moment: Lumen-facing complex with two waters and counted products.

teacher_lines.roman: Water splitting electron supply aur oxygen kaise deti hai?
Ab PS II ki replacement supply ko water splitting se jodenge, aur electrons, oxygen aur protons ka hisaab unki sahi location par rakhenge.
teacher_lines.note: overview · screen: Realistic thylakoid membrane cutaway mein PS II se carriers aur PS I tak pehle se jaana electron route faint rahe; PS II ke paas water input highlight ho.

teacher_lines.roman: Humne dekha tha ki PS II se electron transport chain PS I ko replacement electrons pahunchati hai.
Lekin PS II khud continuously electrons kaise supply karega?
Dekho, PS II ke donated electrons ki replacement water splitting se milti hai, isliye uski supply sirf pehle se maujood electrons par nahi tikti.
Yahaan teen baatein follow karenge: replacement ka route, products ka balanced hisaab, aur membrane par unki release location.
Splitting of water woh process hai jisme water se electrons, H⁺ aur oxygen milte hain; yeh PS II se associated hai.
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: Ussi membrane picture par water se PS II ki replacement arrow judti hai; PS II → carriers → PS I route highlight hota hai aur oxygen output alag nikalta hai.

teacher_lines.roman: Is process ko photolysis bhi kehte hain: photo light ko aur lysis splitting ko batata hai.
Water ke electrons PS II ki electron kami poori karte hain, aur PS II transport chain ke through PS I ki kami poori karta hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki water splitting PS I ko directly refill karti hai, par asal mein yahaan replacement route pehle PS II se guzarta hai.
Oxygen photosynthesis ke net products mein hai; net products poori process ka overall hisaab karne ke baad milne wale substances hain.
Pehle dekha [O] shorthand kya actual released gas tha?
Dekho, [O] oxygen-atom equivalent ka accounting symbol tha, jabki released oxygen gas O₂ hoti hai.
Socho, ek chalti packing line par pehla worker token doosre worker ko deta hai, jo use aage dispatch kar deta hai.
teacher_lines.note: analogy · screen: Supply box → worker PS II → carrier line → worker PS I ka token-flow model; khaali slot aur refill ek-ek karke dikhte hain.

teacher_lines.roman: Pehla worker har handover ke baad apne supply box se naya token leta hai.
Supply box band ho jaaye, toh continuous handover kyun rukega?
Dekho, pehle worker ka khaali token-slot refill nahi hoga, isliye downstream line ko regular supply nahi mil paayegi.
Yahaan supply box water hai, pehla worker PS II hai, beech ki line electron carriers hain, aur doosra worker PS I hai.
Tokens electrons hain; water se PS II ki replacement downstream electron supply ko chalne deti hai.
Ab do water molecules ka batch lo: 2H₂O → 4H⁺ + O₂ + 4e⁻.
teacher_lines.note: example · screen: Ussi PS II picture ke paas do water molecular models expand hon; 4 H⁺, 1 O₂ aur 4 e⁻ counted groups banen, saath atom aur charge ledger ho.

teacher_lines.roman: H⁺ aur electron ke charges hum pehle khol chuke hain; 4e⁻ yahaan chaar electrons ki count dikhata hai.
Do H₂O mein total chaar hydrogen atoms aur do oxygen atoms hain.
Products mein chaar H⁺ aur ek O₂ molecule wahi atom-count sambhalte hain; chaar electrons electron-supply ledger mein aate hain.
Charge ka balance bhi milta hai?
Dekho, reactant water ka total charge zero hai, aur products ke +4 proton charges tatha −4 electron charges milkar zero dete hain.
Isliye har ek O₂ ke saath do waters ki oxidation se chaar replacement electrons aur chaar H⁺ milte hain.
Water electrons deta hai, isliye yeh water ki oxidation hai; light-driven machinery is electron extraction ko possible banati hai.
Ab products ki location samajhne ke liye usi thylakoid membrane ko cross-section mein dekho.
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: Ussi realistic membrane cutaway mein lumen andar aur stroma bahar label hon; membrane-embedded PS II ka water-splitting complex lumen-facing surface par highlight ho.

teacher_lines.roman: Thylakoid sacs ko hum grana ke building units pehchaan chuke hain; membrane se ghiri unki andar ki jagah lumen hai.
Bahar surrounding fluid stroma hai, jise hum pehle locate kar chuke hain.
Water splitting complex water oxidise karne wali PS II-associated machinery hai, jo membrane ke lumen-facing side par hoti hai.
Inner side ka matlab yahaan thylakoid lumen ki taraf wala face hai, poore chloroplast ki koi bhi andar wali jagah nahi.
Kya poora PS II lumen mein freely tairta hai?
Dekho, PS II membrane mein embedded complex hai, aur uska water-splitting apparatus lumen ki taraf face karta hai.
Socho, phir aage badhenge: water-splitting machinery lumen-facing hai, toh bane H⁺ aur O₂ pehle lumen mein release honge ya stroma mein?
teacher_lines.note: checkpoint · screen: Ussi membrane picture mein 4 H⁺ lumen mein appear hon, O₂ lumen side se outward diffusion path le, aur 4 e⁻ PS II ko route hon.

teacher_lines.roman: Apne jawab ko machinery ke face se jodo; sirf compartment ka naam yaad mat karo.
Dekho, reaction lumen-facing side par hoti hai, isliye H⁺ aur O₂ lumen side par release hote hain, jabki electrons PS II ki replacement supply mein jaate hain.
Kya oxygen wahin permanently band rahegi?
Dekho, O₂ baad mein diffuse karke bahar ja sakti hai; formation ki location aur final destination alag baatein hain.
Lumen mein mile H⁺ ka ATP formation se sambandh hum aage dekhenge.
Sunlit crop field se atmosphere mein pahunchne wali photosynthetic oxygen ka origin isi water oxidation mein hai.
teacher_lines.note: real_world · screen: Sunlit crop leaf se chloroplast aur lumen-facing water splitting tak zoom; water ki oxygen ko O₂ ban kar stomatal route se atmosphere tak trace kiya jaaye.

teacher_lines.roman: Released oxygen ke water-source ka isotope evidence hum pehle establish kar chuke hain.
Ab us evidence ka mechanism kya mila?
Dekho, PS II-associated water splitting oxygen banati hai, isliye air ki oxygen supply ka sambandh leaf ke water input se judta hai, CO₂ ki oxygen nikaalne se nahi.
Poora connection jodo: PS II electron donate karta hai, aur lumen-facing water-splitting complex uski replacement supply deta hai.
teacher_lines.note: retell · screen: Ussi completed local membrane picture mein teen quiet routes: electrons → PS II → PS I; H⁺ → lumen; O₂ → outward diffusion. Neeche balanced equation rahe.

teacher_lines.roman: Do waters se chaar electrons, chaar H⁺ aur ek O₂ milte hain; atoms aur total charge conserved rehte hain.
Electrons PS II ko milte hain, phir transport chain PS I ki replacement karti hai.
H⁺ aur O₂ lumen side par release hote hain; O₂ baad mein bahar diffuse kar sakti hai.
Water yahaan electron source hai, jabki photosystems ki excitation ko energy light deti hai.
Ab replacement electrons ka source clear hai; agle heading mein dekhenge ki electrons aage nikalne ya PS I par lautne se non-cyclic aur cyclic photophosphorylation kaise alag hoti hain.
